name: Spring Branch Memorial Library
description: Harris County Public Library branch with a preschool storytime (ages 3–6) that ends with a themed craft.
tip: Storytime tickets can run out. Arrive 15 minutes early and ask at the children's desk.

name: Ring Neighborhood Library
description: Houston Public Library branch on Long Point with a weekday toddler storytime.
tip: Free tickets for storytime are usually handed out about 30 minutes before it starts.

name: Hillendahl Neighborhood Library
description: Houston Public Library branch on Gessner with toddler and family storytimes.
tip: Family storytime suits preschoolers and early elementary kids together, handy with siblings.

name: Haden Park
description: About 12 acres with a forest-themed play area, restored wetlands and a dog park.
tip: The wetland boardwalk is a good short walk for little legs after the playground.

name: Agnes Moffitt Park
description: One of the largest city parks in Spring Branch, about 40 acres on the west side of the district.
tip: Plenty of open space for scooters, bikes and a picnic.

name: Freed Park
description: A 15-acre neighborhood park in the heart of Spring Branch.
tip: Pair it with a trip to Ring Library on Long Point.

name: Edith L. Moore Nature Sanctuary
description: Houston Audubon's 17.5-acre woodland along Rummel Creek, with a historic log cabin, trails and paid nature programs for kids.
tip: Parking by the cabin is tight. Houston Audubon suggests the Memorial Drive United Methodist Church lot for programs.

name: Frolic's Castle at Memorial City Mall
description: A free three-story castle play area in the mall for kids under 48 inches, plus Puffy's Playground for toddlers under 32 inches.
tip: Socks required. Weekday mornings are the quietest.

name: Christ the King Presbyterian indoor play area
description: A free indoor play area at a Spring Branch church, open to the public some weekday mornings.
tip: Hours vary by source, so call the church before you go.

name: CityCentre
address: 800 Town and Country Blvd, Houston, TX 77024
description: Walkable shopping and dining district with a central plaza that hosts free seasonal events, including a holiday celebration.
tip: The plaza lawn is a good spot to let kids run while grown-ups grab dinner.

name: Terry Hershey Park
address: Memorial Dr, between Beltway 8 and Hwy 6, Houston, TX 77079
description: Harris County park with miles of paved, stroller-friendly trails along Buffalo Bayou, just west of Spring Branch.
tip: Paved and mostly flat, so it's great for balance bikes.

name: Houston Arboretum & Nature Center
description: 155 acres of woods, ponds and easy trails on the edge of Memorial Park, with toddler nature walks, caregiver-and-me classes and free family days.
tip: The short loop around Arrowwood Pond is perfect for little walkers, and there's usually a turtle or two to spot.

name: Vale-Asche Foundation Playground, Memorial Park
address: Memorial Loop Dr near Arnot St, Houston, TX 77007
description: An accessible playground in Memorial Park designed so kids of all abilities can play together.
tip: Combine it with a stroller loop and a picnic, then check the Conservancy calendar for free movie nights on the lawn.

name: The Bunny Hive Houston
cost: Classes by drop-in, pack or membership
description: A social club for little ones (2 weeks to kindergarten) and their grownups, in a renovated Heights bungalow, with daily classes and birthday parties.
tip: Try the two-week intro offer to sample different classes before committing.
